skill.summary: Amazon AppStream API skill. Use when working with Amazon AppStream for root. Covers 79 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lap-amazon-appstream skill.

- Provides access to 79 Amazon AppStream API endpoints for resource management and configuration.
- Supports AWS SigV4 authentication.
- Allows association, creation, description, and deletion of AppStream resources such as app blocks, fleets, stacks, images, and users.
- Requires the AMAZON_APPSTREAM_API_KEY environment variable for operation.
- For full endpoint details, refer to references/api-spec.lap.
